note: Starter benchmark set — 12 image briefs across 6 categories. Expand toward 50 per ROADMAP P1. Each entry: id, category, brief (judge target), prompt (structured), variation.

image_briefs.brief: premium wireless earbuds on dark stone, single focal point, studio light, restrained palette
image_briefs.prompt: premium matte-black wireless earbuds in an open charging case on dark slate, macro 100mm, one softbox key light from upper left, subtle rim, deep shadows, restrained saturation, commercial product photography, no text
image_briefs.variation: shallow depth of field with mist

image_briefs.brief: artisanal perfume bottle with citrus elements, elegant, clean negative space for headline
image_briefs.prompt: an artisanal glass perfume bottle beside fresh orange slices and blossom, bright airy studio, composition weighted right with clean negative space left, soft window light, pastel palette, editorial product photo, no text

image_briefs.brief: elderly clockmaker character portrait, warm workshop, single focal point, painterly
image_briefs.prompt: portrait of an elderly clockmaker with magnifying spectacles examining a brass gear, cluttered warm workshop bokeh, 85mm shallow depth, single warm key light from the left, Rembrandt lighting, painterly realism, no text
image_briefs.variation: side profile bent over the workbench

image_briefs.brief: young astronaut child in cardboard rocket, whimsical, warm evening light
image_briefs.prompt: a child in a homemade cardboard astronaut helmet sitting in a cardboard box rocket, suburban backyard at golden hour, low angle, warm rim light, fireflies, Kodak Portra grade, whimsical realism, no text
image_briefs.variation: looking up at the first stars

image_briefs.brief: misty mountain monastery at dawn, single focal point, atmospheric depth, restrained
image_briefs.prompt: a remote stone monastery on a cliff edge above a sea of morning mist, dawn light from the right, layered mountain silhouettes, small warm window lights, muted blue-gold palette, atmospheric perspective, no people, no text
image_briefs.variation: a single monk crossing the rope bridge

image_briefs.brief: cyberpunk alley ramen stall at night, neon vs steam, one clear subject
image_briefs.prompt: a tiny ramen stall in a rain-slicked neon alley at night, steam rising through red lantern light, low angle 24mm, single vendor silhouette as focal point, teal and red palette, wet reflections, cinematic, no text

image_briefs.brief: finance dashboard hero illustration, flat vector, calm palette, negative space
image_briefs.prompt: flat vector illustration of a calm mountain landscape made of layered chart lines and gradients, dominant colors deep navy and mint, generous negative space upper left for headline, minimal geometric style, no text, no UI chrome

image_briefs.brief: cooking app onboarding illustration, friendly 3D clay style, single subject
image_briefs.prompt: a friendly 3D clay-render chef hat and wooden spoon floating over a soft ceramic plate, pastel peach and sage palette, soft even studio light, centered single subject, generous margins, playful minimal, no text
image_briefs.variation: with a soft shadow only, no plate

image_briefs.brief: stylized health potion bottle game prop, readable silhouette, centered
image_briefs.prompt: a stylized glass health potion bottle with glowing red liquid and cork, hand-painted game art style, strong readable silhouette, centered on neutral dark background, rim light, painterly texture, no text
image_briefs.variation: empty cracked variant of the same bottle

image_briefs.brief: ancient stone golem character concept, front view, clear silhouette
image_briefs.prompt: an ancient moss-covered stone golem character concept, front view T-pose tendency, glowing rune core, clear readable silhouette on neutral gradient background, AAA concept art, consistent top-left key light, no text

image_briefs.brief: vintage tin sign reading BEAST STUDIO, ornate gold lettering, legible
image_briefs.prompt: a vintage enamel tin sign on a workshop wall reading "BEAST STUDIO" in ornate gold serif lettering, rivets and patina, warm bulb light from above, shallow depth, photorealistic, lettering must be exactly correct and legible

image_briefs.brief: neon sign reading OPEN LATE, moody alley, legible glowing letters
image_briefs.prompt: a pink neon sign reading "OPEN LATE" mounted on dark brick in a moody alley, glow reflecting on wet pavement, legible glowing cursive letters exactly as written, cinematic night palette, no other text
